'''Eward''' can refer to three different [[Two Rivers]] residents:

*[[Eward Candwin]] - a stout man who was present in the [[Battle of Emond's Field]].
*[[Eward Congar]] - referenced by [[Mat Cauthon]] when the group is in [[Baerlon]].
